Directions: Refer to the following excerpt, then answer each question that follows.
Content: “We, therefore, the people of the State of South Carolina, in convention assembled, do declare and ordain . . . that the several acts and parts of acts of the Congress of the United States, purporting to be laws for the imposing of duties and imposts on the importation of foreign commodities . . . are unauthorized by the Constitution of the United States, and violate the true meaning and intent thereof and are null, void, and no law, nor binding upon this State. . . .”
